Headquartered in Paris, the firm supports clients globally with structured finance, M&A advisory, capital markets access, and risk management solutions. Natixis is particularly active in sectors like infrastructure, energy, and real estate, and is known for its expertise in sustainable finance and ESG-linked products. It has a strong European footprint and continues to grow internationally, with an emphasis on integrated, client-led solutions.

Name: Financial Analyst - Internship
Company Description: Accuracy is an independent international advisory firm founded in Paris in 2004. The company supports corporate leaders and investors with strategic guidance and expert analysis on high-stakes matters including transactions, valuations, restructuring, disputes, crises, and performance strategy. With around 80 partners and approximately 750 staff across 17 offices worldwide, Accuracy is recognized for its conflict-free, multidisciplinary approach and commitment to objectivity and tailored solutions.

Name: Internship - M&A Analyst
Company Description: AURIS Finance is a French advisory firm specializing in mergers and acquisitions, capital raising, and financial restructuring for small and medium-sized enterprises. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Paris, the company provides tailored strategic support to business owners throughout the entire transaction process. AURIS Finance is known for its sector expertise and ability to navigate the complexities of corporate divestitures and acquisitions. It combines local market knowledge with personalized guidance to help clients optimize their corporate structure and maximize value during ownership transitions.

Name: Strategy Consulting Intern - TMT
Company Description: Altman Solon is a global strategy consulting firm focused exclusively on the telecommunications, media, and technology (TMT) sectors. Formed through the 2020 merger of Altman Vilandrie & Company and Solon Management Consulting, the firm brings deep industry insight, analytical rigor, and strategic clarity to corporate and investor clients. With offices in North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, Altman Solon advises on growth strategy, due diligence, digital transformation, and organizational design, serving many of the world's leading TMT companies and private equity firms.

Name: Internship - Investment Analyst - September 2026
Company Description: myVesta is a turnkey real estate investment firm that provides end to end support for individual and professional investors throughout the acquisition process. Based on two integrated verticals, the company specializes in sourcing and analyzing properties through its transaction department while managing execution and renovation through its general contractor division. The firm is known for its structured approach and its ability to deliver comprehensive management services for complex real estate operations. By combining analytical rigor with operational expertise, myVesta helps clients navigate property investments from initial sourcing to final renovation.

Name: 2027 - M&A Internship
Company Description: Lazard is a global financial advisory and asset management firm known for its independent, client-centric approach to M&A, restructuring, capital markets, and investment strategy. Headquartered in New York and Paris, the firm operates across more than 40 countries and serves corporations, governments, and institutional investors. Lazard’s financial advisory division is one of the most prestigious in the world, regularly advising on complex, high-value transactions, activist defence, and strategic reviews. Its asset management arm offers a broad range of strategies across equities, fixed income, and alternatives, with a strong presence in fundamental research and emerging markets. With roots dating back to the 19th century, Lazard is known for its discretion, deep bench of senior advisers, and emphasis on long-term client relationships across sectors and regions.

Name: Off Cycle Internship Programme
Company Description: Barclays is a British multinational bank offering retail, corporate, and investment banking services across the UK and globally. With roots dating back to 1690, it has played a central role in the evolution of modern banking. Headquartered in London, the firm is a major player in global capital markets, advising on M&A, underwriting debt and equity, and providing financing solutions. Its retail and commercial divisions serve millions of customers, while its investment bank operates across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and the Middle East.

Name: Various Internships - January 2027
Company Description: Tikehau Capital is a Paris-based alternative asset manager investing across private debt, real estate, private equity, and capital markets strategies. The firm manages over €40 billion in assets and is known for backing entrepreneurs and businesses across Europe with flexible, long-term capital. Tikehau blends institutional-grade investment with a strong entrepreneurial culture and takes an active approach to value creation across its portfolio. With offices in key financial centres and a growing international presence, the firm is also focused on responsible investment and integrating ESG principles into its strategy.

Name: 2027 Off-Cycle Internship, Infrastructure Real Assets
Company Description: Macquarie Group is a global financial services firm headquartered in Sydney, Australia, offering services across asset management, banking, commodities, and capital markets. Known for its entrepreneurial culture and decentralised structure, Macquarie operates through specialised groups that manage infrastructure, green energy, real estate, and credit investments worldwide. It is one of the world’s largest infrastructure asset managers and a major player in commodity trading and energy finance. The firm’s global advisory and capital markets division supports clients with M&A, equity, and debt financing, often with a focus on complex or cross-border transactions. Macquarie has expanded significantly in Europe and North America and is recognised for combining risk discipline with innovation across sectors including renewables, tech, and transportation.

Name: Various Internships
Company Description: Kroll is a global risk and financial advisory firm headquartered in New York, providing services in investigations, compliance, cyber security, valuations, and corporate finance. Known historically for its forensic investigations and intelligence gathering, Kroll has evolved into a multidisciplinary adviser for clients navigating fraud, litigation, governance, and data risk. The firm supports corporates, governments, law firms, and financial institutions in managing reputational, operational, and financial challenges, often in high-stakes or crisis scenarios. Kroll also operates as a major provider of independent valuation and fairness opinions for transactions, tax reporting, and litigation support. With a growing presence in cyber defence and ESG advisory, Kroll continues to expand its offerings at the intersection of technology, finance, and security.

Name: 2027 Off-cycle Internship Program
Company Description: BlackRock is the world’s largest asset manager, overseeing trillions in assets across index funds, ETFs, active strategies, and alternatives. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in New York, the firm serves institutional, corporate, and retail investors worldwide. Its product suite includes iShares, the world’s most widely used ETF platform, and Aladdin, its proprietary risk and portfolio management system. BlackRock plays a major role in global capital markets, with influence over long-term investment trends, ESG integration, and financial technology innovation.

Name: 2027 - Investment Banking Off Cycle Internship
Company Description: Nomura is a Japanese multinational financial services group headquartered in Tokyo, with operations in investment banking, asset management, and retail brokerage. The firm serves corporates, governments, and institutional clients globally, offering advisory, capital markets, and trading services. Nomura is a market leader in Asia and maintains a growing presence in EMEA and the Americas, with particular strengths in structured finance, macro trading, and cross-border dealmaking. It also provides a wide range of public and private market investment strategies through Nomura Asset Management. The firm blends domestic scale with international ambition, and is actively investing in digital platforms and sustainability-led finance.

Name: 6-Month Internship - Investment Analyst
Company Description: PIMCO (Pacific Investment Management Company) is one of the world’s leading fixed income investment managers, overseeing over $2 trillion in assets for institutions, governments, and individuals globally. Headquartered in Newport Beach, California, the firm offers a wide range of bond strategies, including core fixed income, credit, emerging markets debt, and alternative income. PIMCO is known for its macroeconomic research, active management style, and risk-controlled portfolios. It also operates in real estate, private credit, and ESG-integrated strategies. A subsidiary of Allianz, PIMCO plays a central role in global bond markets and has a strong presence in both public and private asset classes.

Name: Off-Cycle Internship - Telecoms Team (January - June 2027)
Company Description: Evercore is a premier global independent investment banking advisory firm, known for advising on complex M&A, capital markets, restructuring, and strategic transactions. Headquartered in New York and founded in 1995, Evercore operates across major financial centres in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. The firm is consistently ranked among the top M&A advisers globally, having advised on some of the largest and most transformative deals in recent decades. Evercore focuses exclusively on advisory—without lending or trading conflicts—positioning itself as a trusted, conflict-free partner to boards, CEOs, and private equity sponsors. The firm also provides institutional equity research and sells insights through its equities division. Known for its talent density, discretion, and analytical rigour, Evercore competes with top-tier Wall Street banks while maintaining an independent, client-focused culture.

Name: 2027 Investment Management Off-Cycle Internship - Real Estate Investing
Company Description: Morgan Stanley is a global financial services firm headquartered in New York, offering investment banking, wealth management, institutional securities, and asset management services. With a strong presence in both the US and international markets, the firm advises clients on mergers and acquisitions, IPOs, debt and equity financing, and strategic investments. Its institutional arm is active in trading, research, and capital markets, while its wealth management division, bolstered by the acquisition of E*TRADE, serves millions of clients globally. Morgan Stanley is widely regarded for its advisory work with corporates and financial sponsors, and it continues to invest in digital platforms, sustainability, and global expansion to maintain its position as one of the world’s top financial institutions.

Name: Private Equity - Investor Relations and ESG - Internship
Company Description: InfraVia Capital Partners is a Paris-based private investment firm founded in 2008 that specialises in infrastructure, real assets, and growth-stage technology investments. The firm deploys large scale equity capital in sectors shaped by digital transformation, decarbonisation, urbanisation, mobility, health, and essential services. InfraVia partners closely with management teams, entrepreneurs, and industrial businesses to support strategic international expansion, operational improvement, ESG integration, and long-term value creation across Europe and beyond.

Headquartered in London, it manages assets across equities, fixed income, multi-asset, private markets, and alternatives for institutional, intermediary, and retail clients worldwide. Schroders is known for its active investment approach, global reach, and strong ESG integration across strategies. The firm has made significant investments in sustainable investing, impact solutions, and private asset capabilities, particularly through its Schroders Capital division. With operations in more than 30 countries, it plays a leading role in shaping responsible investing practices globally.

Ardian operates through a network of offices worldwide and backs businesses at multiple stages, from buyouts to growth investments. The firm is also active in secondaries and co-investments and has built a strong reputation around investor alignment and ESG integration.
